summary: Japan’s export growth slowed a tad in August while remaining at an elevated pace, with shipments of semiconductors and chip manufacturing equipment surging.

title: New Zealand’s World-Beating Sovereign Wealth Fund Returns 14.2%
summary: The New Zealand Superannuation Fund, one of the world’s top-performing sovereign wealth funds, returned 14.2% in the year through June, powered by a rally in global equity markets despite being underweight in outperforming tech stocks.

title: Asian Stocks Steady as Traders Await Fed Decision: Markets Wrap
summary: Asian stocks were broadly steady as elevated oil prices and rising bond yields kept investors cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision.

title: Shrinking Chinese Fuel Inventories Raise Chance of Export Curbs
summary: China’s gasoline and diesel inventories are plunging as refiners grapple with a tightening domestic market, raising the chance the government may move to limit fuel exports again.

title: Gold Steadies Below $4,300 as Markets Await Fed Rate Decision
summary: Gold was steady as high oil prices continued to fuel inflation concerns and keep interest-rate hike bets a near-certainty ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision later Wednesday.

title: Apollo Gives $585 Million of Financing to The Executive Centre
summary: Apollo Global Management has provided $585 million of financing to flexible workspace provider The Executive Centre, according to a statement, in the global asset manager’s largest Asian hybrid deal combining debt and equity.

title: Thai Finance Chief Sticks to 2.5% Growth Goal
summary: Thai Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas is sticking with the government’s forecast for 2.5% economic growth this year despite the surge in oil prices. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed Seen Hiking Rates in Defiance of Trump: Decision-Day Guide
summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to lift interest rates on Wednesday for the first time since 2023 as policymakers lose confidence that inflation will cool sufficiently without at least a nudge from the central bank.

title: Oaktree Sees Credit Investors ‘Finally Being Paid to Take Risk’
summary: Credit investors are “being paid to take risk, finally,” according to Oaktree Capital Management’s Danielle Poli.

title: Retirement Math Difficult for Investors, says BlackRock's Magyera
summary: Jaime Magyera, BlackRock senior managing director and head of US Wealth and head of Retirement, said advisers are using artificial intelligence to help parse increasingly complex capital markets after AI company Anthropic announces new ties with Blackrock. Magyera also said that AI is helping create more strategic customization for clients. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Blackstone Seeks $8 Billion for Green Infrastructure Credit Fund
summary: Blackstone Inc. is seeking to raise at least $8 billion for its private credit fund focused on renewables and digital infrastructure investments, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Market Attractive But Issues Lurk, Oaktree's Poli Says
summary: Oaktree Portfolio Manager Danielle Poli says markets may continue to see upward pressure on yields because investors do not yet believe inflation will be fully tamed. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dutch Bros CEO Christine Barone on Expansion & Inflation
summary: Christine Barone, President & CEO of Dutch Bros, discussed the company’s aggressive growth strategy, saying the chain aims to reach 2,029 shops by 2029 and expects to add at least 185 locations this year. She said that pace is supported by a strong internal talent pipeline, with more than 500 operators ready to move into new states and markets as the company expands. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wealthy Clients Want 'Shiny Star' Investments, Says Rick Pitcairn
summary: Rick Pitcairn, chairman and chief global strategist at family office Pitcairn, said its his job to tap the breaks on wealthy clients who want to put too much of their money in 'shiny star' investments like SpaceX or private markets. Pitcairn said that there is a role for private credit and private markets, but it should be inside a diverse portfolio.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US 10-Year Yield Rises to Highest Since 2007 as Fed Looms
summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield rose to the highest in almost two decades, the latest milestone in a bruising global bond selloff driven by booming capital investment and soaring energy prices that are exacerbating inflation.

title: Beijing-Backed Construction Contractor on HK's Five-Year Plan
summary: Zhou Zhike, Assistant President at China State Construction International, discusses expectations for Hong Kong's five-year plan and the outlook for opportunities for his company in the Greater Bay Area. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Emerging Assets Extend Four-Day Slide as Oil, 5% US Yield Bite
summary: Emerging-market stocks and currencies fell for a fourth session as rising global bond yields and oil prices kept riskier assets under pressure.

title: Venezuela Oil Opening Is ‘Smoke and Mirrors,’ Pickering Says
summary: Recent high-profile deals allowing foreign drillers to tap Venezuela’s vast oil reserves have failed to quell lingering concerns about contract sanctity in a nation with a history of nationalization, said energy investment banker Dan Pickering.

title: Bond Market’s ‘Extreme’ Short Counts on Fed to Deliver Rate Hike
summary: Bond traders have piled into bearish positions ahead of Wednesday’s Federal Reserve meeting, betting that the Treasury selloff driving yields to their highest levels in almost two decades will continue.

title: Gold Isn't Driven by US Inflation Says Jan van Eck
summary: Jan van Eck, CEO of VanEck Funds joined Bloomberg Businessweek Daily from Future Proof to discuss the state of the global economy. He says he isn't worried about the $40 Trillion US debt and that Bessent and Trump are 'toying' with the market when it comes to the idea of sending $5,000 checks to Americans if they keep control of Congress. (Source: Bloomberg)
